objective: Prove structural equivalence of 474 verification_equivalence_keys via code inspection, build true equivalence classes, live-test one representative per class, promote only exact-equivalent siblings
starting_materials: PHASE_3B_MECHANISM_FAMILIES.json — 12 loose family groupings (DO NOT use for promotion)
serum-mcp source: mapping.py, schema.py, spec.py, introspect.py

step_1_derive_structural_keys.task: For each of 474 equivalence_keys, extract the EXACT structural properties from mapping.py + schema.py that define write/read behavior
extract: write_mechanism (e.g., 'direct dict assignment', 'enum index lookup', 'loop iteration with shared list')
step_1_derive_structural_keys.evidence_source: grep mapping.py for write loops (e.g., _OSC_KEYS iteration, _FILTER_KEYS loop); grep schema.py for raw param definitions (type, range, enum); grep introspect.py for reverse extraction

step_2_build_equivalence_classes.task: Group 474 keys by their EXACT structural equivalence
step_2_build_equivalence_classes.rule: Two keys belong to the same equivalence class ONLY if: same raw_module pattern + same raw_parameter mapping + same write_mechanism + same value_kind + same conversion + same presence_semantics + same reverse_mechanism
step_2_build_equivalence_classes.merge_candidates: e.g., if mapping.py proves lfo1.rate, lfo2.rate, ..., lfo6.rate all use the exact same LFO{i}.plainParams.kParamRate write via shared loop, they form ONE equivalence class with 6 siblings
step_2_build_equivalence_classes.do_not_merge: e.g., if field has different presence_semantics (some optional, some conditional), keep separate; if reverse-extraction differs (some curve data vs scalars), keep separate
step_2_build_equivalence_classes.expected_output: ~40-80 TRUE equivalence classes (much smaller than 474 keys; smaller than 12 families)

step_3_select_representatives.task: For each true equivalence class, select ONE representative control to live-test in Serum 2.0.21 GUI
step_3_select_representatives.selection_criteria: Choose lowest-index slot or simplest member (e.g., lfo1 for lfo1-6 class, env1 for env1-4 class, fx.delay over fx.bode for FXDelay sub-params)

step_4_live_test_representatives.task: For each representative, test in Serum 2.0.21 GUI (same methodology as Phase 2D)
procedure: Generate test preset via serum-mcp with representative set to non-default test value
Load .SerumPreset in Ableton Live hosting Serum 2.0.21
Navigate to relevant GUI control (OSC/Filter/ENV/LFO/MATRIX/ARP/FX/GLOBAL tab)
Read actual control value via tooltip/numeric display
Document: PASS (exact match) | PARTIAL (indirect match, display limitation) | FAIL (no effect, wrong value, missing control)
step_4_live_test_representatives.pass_criteria: Exact match or plausible indirect match (e.g., Hz display vs normalized 0-1 requested, dB vs linear volume)

step_5_promote_and_recount.task: Apply test results to update classification
step_5_promote_and_recount.rule_pass: If representative PASSES: all siblings in that equivalence class become AUTO_VERIFIED (they share identical write/reverse mechanism, proven by representative)
step_5_promote_and_recount.rule_fail: If representative FAILS: entire equivalence class becomes MANUAL_REQUIRED (with failure reason)
step_5_promote_and_recount.rule_partial: If representative PARTIAL (e.g., describe_preset display limitation, not data corruption): mark as OBSERVATION_GAP_CONFIRMED with workaround note; keep AUTO_VERIFIED if underlying write/read mechanism works

fields.terminal_state: RECOMPUTED (AUTO_VERIFIED if 3B class passed, else OBSERVATION_GAP/MANUAL_REQUIRED)
fields.phase_3b_equivalence_class: NEW — which class this control belongs to

step_6_recompute_bridge.integrity_check: 1,136 rows total, 0 missing, 0 duplicates, 0 silent drops

expected_outcomes.scenario_all_classes_pass: 657 OBSERVATION_GAP + some UNRESOLVED -> bulk promoted to AUTO_VERIFIED. New totals: ~400-500 AUTO_VERIFIED, reduced OBSERVATION_GAP/UNRESOLVED.
expected_outcomes.scenario_mixed: Some classes pass (promoted), others fail (MANUAL_REQUIRED). Granular, selective promotion — only exact-equivalent siblings promoted.
expected_outcomes.scenario_all_fail: No classes pass. 657 OBSERVATION_GAP + 282 UNRESOLVED remain unchanged. Phase 4 proceeds with narrower AUTO scope (only 133 from Phase 2D).

success_criteria: True equivalence classes built (not family-level shortcuts)
Live tests executed for all representatives
Promotion applied ONLY to exact-equivalent siblings
Zero silent drops, zero silent inflations, every control accounted for
next_phase: Phase 3D (final recount) → Phase 4 (production reproduction) → Phase 5 (final proof)
